title: Find the IDs of players who scored the highest number of partnership runs f
question: Find the IDs of players who scored the highest number of partnership runs for each match. The output should include the IDs of two players, each with their individual scores and the total partnership score. For each pair, the player with the higher individual score should be listed as player 1, and the player with the lower score as player 2. In cases where both players have the same score, the player with the higher ID should be player 1, and the player with the lower ID should be player 2. There can be multiple rows for a single match.

prediction.sql:
WITH pair_runs AS (
  SELECT b.match_id, b.striker AS p1, b.non_striker AS p2,
         SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored,0)) AS runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored s
    ON s.match_id=b.match_id AND s.over_id=b.over_id AND s.ball_id=b.ball_id AND s.innings_no=b.innings_no
  GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.striker, b.non_striker
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT match_id, p1, p2, runs,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY runs DESC, p1 DESC, p2 DESC) AS rn
  FROM pair_runs
)
SELECT match_id,
       CASE WHEN p1>=p2 THEN p1 ELSE p2 END AS player1,
       CASE WHEN p1>=p2 THEN p2 ELSE p1 END AS player2,
       runs AS total
FROM ranked WHERE rn=1
ORDER BY match_id
